title: Sample Manifest v1
description: Companion schema for spec/judge-record-family-v1.md section 4. The root schema validates a Sample Manifest record: which cases were selected for evaluation, under which sampling policy, stratified how. epistemic_type is fixed to producer_claim -- the sampler's own statement of what it selected, unverified by the store until an evaluation-report/v1 cites the same case ids.

judge_purpose.description: spec/judge-record-family-v1.md section 0 -- why this record cites the target, from the judge_purpose namespace that document owns. Not the Capsule citation_purpose field (REGISTRY.md section 11) and not an Evidence Layer link type (section 18); a citation_purpose member here is rejected.

stratification.description: Case count by stratum, e.g. {"held_out": 40, "regression": 10}. Open keys -- strata are policy-defined, not a closed vocabulary this schema owns.
